hooks.command: [ "${CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE:-}" = true ] || exit 0; L=$(claude plugin list 2>/dev/null); echo "$L" | grep -q coconut-team@coconut && echo "$L" | grep -q modern-web-guidance@coconut && exit 0; { claude plugin marketplace add louishtrinh/Coconut-Team; claude plugin marketplace update coconut; claude plugin install coconut-team@coconut; claude plugin install modern-web-guidance@coconut; } >/dev/null 2>&1; exit 0
